agent-id.description: Stable agent identity assigned by its authoritative source, scoped to that source.

framework.description: Agent framework, for example LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI.

instance-id.description: Identifier of the particular running agent instance or session.

model-id.description: Model identifier observed for this agent at the time of the activity.

model-name.description: Name of the model backing this agent.

version.description: Agent code or configuration revision, distinct from the model version.

description: An autonomous AI agent with a stable logical identifier and an optional runtime instance identifier, framework, revision and model context. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/ai_agent.
name: ai-agent
